summary: Liberty Defense Holdings, Ltd. (Nasdaq: DETX) filed a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, disclosing that CEO Bill Frain is resigning effective October 31, 2026, and stepping down from the board immediately; COO Keith Teichmann becomes Interim CEO. Frain remains through month-end for an orderly transition, with Chairman John Percival voicing board support. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or break fee is stated. The abrupt leadership change leaves a permanent-CEO search overhang and execution risk on HEXWAVE and HD-AIT rollouts; watch follow-on 8-K/6-K disclosures and any strategic review.
